europe_now.title: Germany records 14,000 heat-related deaths during summer heatwaves
europe_now.summary: Official data show that Germany recorded 14,000 heat-related deaths this summer as heatwaves swept across Europe. The fatalities highlight the broad public health impact of extreme summer weather.

sources.headline: Germany records 14,000 heat-related deaths this summer as heatwaves scorch Europe

europe_now.title: EU defends International Criminal Court against US sanctions
europe_now.summary: The European Union has denounced US sanctions on the ICC president and a senior prosecutor as an attack on judicial independence. EU officials argue the measures undermine the court's ability to prosecute international crimes.

sources.headline: ICC slams US decision to sanction the court's president and a senior prosecution lawyer
ICC says US sanctions 'flagrant attack' on court independence

top_stories.title: Ceuta faces deepening humanitarian crisis
top_stories.summary: FRANCE 24 reports that Ceuta's health system is collapsing amid a growing humanitarian crisis. Migrant women in Ceuta have reported widespread sexual harassment in the crisis-hit enclave.

sources.headline: Migrant women tell of sexual harassment in Spain's crisis-hit Ceuta

top_stories.title: Russian strikes cause casualties in Kyiv amid air defence shortages
top_stories.summary: Reports indicate that at least 13 people were killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages. Additional strikes in the surrounding region have left at least 12 dead, underscoring ongoing Russian offensive pressure.
